'''OL701'''<ref name="Lost stars">''[[Lost Stars]]''</ref> was a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Hoth]], OL701, along with [[CR978]], [[JA189]], and [[Penrie|NA811]], was sent into the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]] to chase down the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="ESB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
OL701's TIE fighter first appeared in the original release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] in [[1980]], although the pilot was not visible in the film.<ref name="ESB" /> OL701 was first identified and heard in the novel ''[[Lost Stars]]'', which was written by [[Claudia Gray]] and released in [[2015]].<ref name="Lost stars" />
